verdict.rationale: Kit is an email marketing SaaS, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant. The Kit MCP lets external MCP-compatible AI clients read and write account data, which belongs to the MCP-server story and does not count as a built-in assistant. Natural-language prompts becoming account actions happen through that external-client route.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
